user_sees: Card line 'A photo of your gym's machine helps you find it. It shows as this exercise's picture.'
Sheet 'Add your photo or video' with 'It stays on this phone. A video can be up to 30 seconds, and it plays without sound when you tap the exercise's picture.'
must_not: The gallery opening under the sheet

steps.action: Tap 'Choose from your gallery' and pick a photo
user_sees: 'Adding your photo or video…' then the picture with 'Change' and 'Remove'
must_not: Save usable while the file is still being copied

steps.action: Fill the rows and tap 'Save exercise'
user_sees: The exercise shows the photo as its picture
must_not: The photo sent off the phone

start: A library exercise, 'Your photo or video' screen

steps.action: Tap 'Add photo or video', then 'Take a photo'
user_sees: The camera opens; the photo shows on the card with 'It shows instead of our picture.'
must_not: The library exercise's name or muscles changed

steps.action: Tap 'Record a video' and record 20 seconds
user_sees: The video kept and plays without sound on the exercise's picture

start: 'New exercise', adding a picture goes wrong

steps.action: Tap 'Take a photo' with the camera refused
user_sees: Pop-up 'Could not add it': 'MettleUp needs the camera for this. You can allow it in your phone settings, or choose from your gallery.'
must_not: A prompt that comes back on every tap

user_sees: 'Pick a video of 30 seconds or less — one or two reps is plenty.'
'That video is too large. Pick a shorter one.'

start: Your own exercise with a photo

steps.action: Open Edit exercise, tap the picture's 'Change'
must_not: The old picture removed before a new one is picked

steps.action: Pick a new photo, tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: The new picture shows; the old file is deleted from the phone
The exercise shows the stand-in picture

steps.action: Pick a photo, then close with X without saving
user_sees: The exercise keeps its old picture

start: A member signed in, own exercise with a gym machine photo

user_sees: The sheet says 'It stays on this phone.'
must_not: The photo uploaded to the cloud copy (the own-exercise cloud row carries no picture)

user_sees: Backup holds the exercise; the picture's path is a phone path
must_not: The photo shared with the gym
